lesson.title: Two ways to see the same step
lesson.skill: Read a picture for the step it shows, and tell when a picture cannot be shown at all.
lesson.missionLink: You have been solving these by moving symbols. This is the same move drawn out, for the days when the algebra is going in circles.

primarySource.why: It draws the same equation as a jump on a number line.

content.text: Adding 4 to both sides is one move, and a number line shows where it lands.

blocks.alt: A number line with 2, 4, and 6 marked, and an arrow from 2 to 4.
blocks.caption: Every step moves by the same amount.

blocks.caption: The model drew this and forgot to say what it shows.
